keyEvents.text: Goal! Augsburg 1, Freiburg 0. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Arijon Ibrahimovic with a cross.
Substitution, Freiburg. Igor Matanovic replaces Lucas Höler.
Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Freiburg. Vincenzo Grifo replaces Derry Scherhant.
Substitution, Freiburg. Keisuke Goto replaces Yuito Suzuki.
Goal! Augsburg 1, Freiburg 1. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Yannik Engelhardt.
Substitution, Augsburg. Mert Kömür replaces Anton Kade.
Substitution, Augsburg. Rodrigo Ribeiro replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
Substitution, Freiburg. Max Rosenfelder replaces Lukas Kübler because of an injury.
Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Augsburg. Alexis Claude-Maurice replaces Arijon Ibrahimovic.
Substitution, Augsburg. Marius Wolf replaces Han-Noah Massengo.
Substitution, Freiburg. Cyriaque Irié replaces Niklas Beste.
Goal! Augsburg 1, Freiburg 2. Cyriaque Irié (Freiburg) header from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Vincenzo Grifo with a cross.
Substitution, Augsburg. Uchenna Ogundu replaces Yannik Keitel.
Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card.
